title: Iku (a Woman’s Name)
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: She is mentioned in Taanit 25a: she was Rabbi Chanina ben Dosa’s neighbor and complained to him that she was building a house and the beams were too short. He asked her name; she said, “Iku.” He said: “Iku, may your beams stretch.”

notes.text: The consulted Taanit passage has נימטו in the appeal about the beams. Hyman’s supplied wording is נממי.
